take: The Islanders announced they placed defenseman Alexander Romanov on injured reserve and recalled right wing Mitchell Chaffee from Hamilton (AHL). Romanov, a second-pair defenseman who plays 16:34 a night and kills penalties, has already missed five games, and in that stretch Adam Pelech has moved in beside Ryan Pulock. Logan Stanley is up to 22:37 a night from 17:52, and Pulock is up to 19:54 from 17:20. New York's penalty kill allows 1.14 expected goals per game, so those heavier minutes matter.
